question: Who wins the Ohio Senate special election in 2026
quote: This just feels like the kind of state that just slips right through your fingers.
turn_text: Yeah, it's funny how all the tush talk has gotten the most attention in this race. I think, you know, Sherrod Brown – 2024 was a really lousy year to be a Democrat, particularly in a state like Ohio. 2026 is not such a bad year to be a Democrat. And I think there was like some poll that indicated like one quarter of Ohio voters believed he was still the incumbent senator. Now, you know, he was in for a long time. He was only out for two years. You think – you know, I almost wonder if you're Houston whether you could have like criticized Brown for the state of the country. But no, unfortunately, I think this is one of those states that once looked very Trumpy and between, you know, tariffs and everything else and the price of gas and stuff like that. This just feels like the kind of state that just slips right through your fingers.
host_quote: Jim Garrity, to Ohio. We have Republican Senator John Husted trying to hold on against former Democratic Senator Sherrod Brown.
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Ohio US Senate special general election. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
outcome_source_title: AP: Sherrod Brown flips Senate seat in Ohio for Democrats by ousting Sen. Jon Husted
